header: What happens to study data after a paper closes
content:
Datasets behind a Northstar paper are deposited before the proof stage and carry the same DOI prefix as the article itself. Authors choose an embargo of up to 24 months; after that the files are public, versioned and citable on their own.

Consent records stay with the originating institution. What the archive hosts is the analysis set, the codebook and whatever scripts rebuild the tables in the published version.
sidebar_content:
Deposit checklist

  • Analysis set and codebook
  • Scripts that rebuild every table
  • Embargo length, up to 24 months

The data desk answers at data@northstarlabs.example within two working days.
